FOREWORD
0.1 This Indian Standard (First Revision) was adopted by the Indian Standards Institution on 3J Marcil 1987, after the draft finalized by the Pelt Control Sectional Committee had been approved by the Agricultural and Food Products Division Council and the Chemical Division Council; 0.% Formothion Be, containing varying percentages of formothion, are largely used in the control of insect pests ot agricultural importance. 0.3 Formothion Be formulations are generally manufactured to contain 2S'0 percent ( mlm ) of formothion. 0.4 This standard was 4rl-t published in 1976. In this revision method of estimation of acidity has been modified. Other requirements are also being up-dated. 0.5 In the preparation of this standard due consideration has been given to the provisions of the Insecticides Act, 1968 and the rules framed thereunder. However, th� standard is subject to the restrictions imposed under these, wherever applicable. 0.6 For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of this standard is complied with, the final value, observed or calculated, expressing the result of a test or analysis, shall be rounded off in accordance with IS: 2-1960�. The number of significant places retained in the rounded off value should be the same as that of the specified value in this standard.

1. SCOPE 1.1 This standard prescribes the requirements and the methods of sampling and tests for formotbi~n Ee.

REQUIREMENTS 2.1 CODstltuents- The material shall consist of formothion, technical solution dissolved in suitabl~ solvent(s) together with emulsifying agent(s) and with or without stabilizer(s). 2.1.1 Formothion, technical solution, employed in the manufacture of this material shall conform to IS : 8024-1976*. 2.2 PlaysJeal- The material shall comply with the physical requirements liven in 2.2.1 to 2.2.5. 2.2.1 Description - The material shall be in the form of clear, stable and homogeneous liquid, free from foreigD matter. Sediment and/or suspended matter shall be negligible. On dilution with water it shall form an emulsion suitable for spray. 2.2.2 Cold Test - No turbidity or separation of solid and/or oily matter shall occur when the material is subjected to the cold test at 10�C as prescribed in 13.1 of IS : 6940-1982t or any other lower temperature a's agreed to between the purchaser and the vendor. 2.2.3 Flash Point (Abel) -When determined by the method prescribed in IS : 1448 [P : 20 ]-1982:, the flash point of the material shall be above 24�SoC.
2.2.4 Emulsion Stability - Any separation including creaming at the top and sedimentation at the bottom of 100 ml of emulsion prepared in standard hard water with 2'0 ml of the concentrate for agriculture use and S�O ml for public health use shall not exceed 2'0 mt when tested by one of the methods prescribed in 13.3 of IS : 6940-1982t.

2.2.5 Heat Stability - After treating in accordance with the method prescribed in 13.4 of IS : 6940-1982t the material shall comply with the requirements of 2.2.1 to 2.2.4 and 2.3.1.
NOTB - The material Deed notYbe put to heat stability treatment if it hu crossed half of Its sbelf life [ .ee 3.2 (c) ].

2.3.1.1 The actual value of formothion content shall be calculated o second decimal place and then rounded off to first decimal place before applying the tolerances given in 2.3.1. 2.3.1.2 The average formothion content of all the samples taken shall not be less than the declared nominal value. 2.3.2 A.cldity/Alkalinity - When tested by the method prescribed in Appendix A of this standard, the acidity (as HISO,), if any, shall be not more than l'S percent by mass. The material shall not be alkallne to Utmus when tested by method given in 13.5.1 of IS : 6940-1982*.

3. PACKING AND MARKING�
3.1 Paddnl - The material shall be packed as per requirements given in IS : 8190 ( Part 2 )-1980t. 3.2 Marking - The containers shall be securely closed and shan bear le.ibly and indelibly the following information in addition to the information as is necessary under the Insect;cid~s Act and rules: a) b) c) d) e) Name of the material and end use; Name of the manutacturer; Date of manufacture and date of expiry; Batch number; Nominal formothion content, percent ( moss/mass ); f) Net volume of contents; and 8) The minimum cautionary notice as worded in Insecticides Act.

5. TESTS
